correct_alts:
X-RateLimit-Remaining goes negative under bursts
- A client received X-RateLimit-Remaining=-3 during a burst.
- The counter is computed in gateway/limiter.go and should clamp at 0.
- Keep the 429 header discussion out of this one.

Clamp X-RateLimit-Remaining at zero
Under burst traffic the gateway reports a remaining quota of -3, a value that makes no sense to clients. The calculation in gateway/limiter.go needs a floor of 0.
